invariants.rationale: The method applies a 10% discount to the input price, so the returned value should be 90% of the input price.
The discounted result should always be less than or equal to the original price.
Assuming non-negative prices, the discounted result should not be negative given direct proportional calculation.
Prices are typically non-negative, so this is likely an intended invariant in the context of processing orders.
The returned result should be exactly 90% of the input price under floating-point arithmetic.
